subject: Partner overlay clearinghouse — Skyline integration pipeline mapping
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@skyline.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Skyline Partnerships <partners@skyline.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner overlap — need a clearinghouse for Skyline + Consultly accounts

Neha,

Hope you're well. We're seeing an increasing number of co-sell and referral introductions where both our rep and Consultly (a systems integrator partner) have active opportunities into the same enterprise accounts. The overlap is already causing duplicated outreach and confusion (and a couple of cold leads becoming unhappy).

Attached is a slice of the account list showing current active opportunities (Skyline_account_list.csv). Quick ask: can Redwood help establish a short-term clearinghouse process so we can avoid stomping on each other's pipelines and preserve co-sell credit? Ideally something lightweight we can use for the next 60 days while we formalize a longer process.

High-level constraints from our side:
- Need a single point of truth for opportunity ownership claims
- Deal registration that prevents duplicate pursuits for 7 business days while partners sync
- Keep the handoff fast — smallest friction for sales reps

Appreciate any recommendations — Alex

Alex Turner
Head of Partnerships, Skyline Analytics
alex.turner@skyline.ai
attachments: Skyline_account_list.csv (csv)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Partner overlap — need a clearinghouse for Skyline + Consultly accounts

Looping you in — Alex sent the attached account list and is asking for a lightweight clearinghouse/process to prevent duplicate outreach between Skyline and Consultly. Marissa/Serge, can alliances propose a short-term playbook we can run for 60 days (and a template for claims)? Jonas, I suspect Sales Ops will need to automate the tie-break rule in HubSpot and ensure the deal registration window.

Key goals:
- Protect partner-sourced pipeline and credits
- Reduce duplicate outreach and conflicting emails to customers
- Minimal manual steps for reps (one single claim form/template)

I attached Alex's CSV and proposed we include a MAP_TEMPLATE for partners to claim or register. Can you take point and draft a quick procedure + owner matrix?

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Alliances & GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
attachments: Skyline_account_list.csv (forwarded)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Partner overlap — clearinghouse proposal (v1)

Thanks Neha — drafted a lightweight "Clearinghouse v1" proposal below. Attaching MAP_TEMPLATE.xlsx as the single claim form. This is intentionally minimal so partners adopt it quickly.

Proposal (Clearinghouse v1) — process and rules:
1) Single Claim Form (MAP_TEMPLATE.xlsx) — partner or account owner submits with: account, primary AE, opportunity name, estimated ACV, evidence (email thread or intro).
2) 72-hour soft-hold window: when a claim is submitted, internal sales will pause outreach for 72 hours to allow validation and partner sync.
3) Ownership score: compute simple priority score (partner-sourced + recent engagement + closed-won history). If tie, Sales Ops rule (see below) breaks tie by most recent registration timestamp.
4) Escalation: if unresolved after 72 hours, route to Alliances (Marissa) + Regional Sales Lead for decision within 24 hours.
5) Visibility: maintain a shared Google Sheet (link below) and log claim IDs into HubSpot (custom field: partner_claim_id).

Suggested cadence:
- Weekly 30-min clearing sync (Mon 11:00) for active claims > $50k
- Monthly retrospective to identify process improvements and edge cases

Attachments: MAP_TEMPLATE.xlsx
Related: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Cskyline-mapping-v1

Marissa Cole
Senior Alliances Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
attachments: MAP_TEMPLATE.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clearinghouse v1 — Ops constraints and HubSpot tie-break

Love the lightweight approach. A few operational constraints and a simple automation I can implement this week:

Sales Ops notes:
- HubSpot: we'll add a custom property (partner_claim_id) and a workflow that flags any active opportunity with a claim. If claim exists, set "partner_hold" = true and pause outbound cadence sequences for the rep.
- Tie-breaker rule: if multiple claims arrive, accept the one with higher ownership_score. If ownership_score ties, choose the earliest claim timestamp. We'll log both claim IDs and keep a trace in the activity feed.
- Ownership window: Ops prefers 72 hours for validation, but we can shorten to 48 hours for deals < $25k to reduce friction.
- Reporting: I'll create a weekly report (HubSpot list) that shows claims and status.

Action items for this thread:
- Marissa: finalize the MAP_TEMPLATE fields (I reviewed — good)
- Neha: confirm escalation owner for unresolved claims (you?)
- Alex/Priya: start using the form for any immediate claims this week

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
attachments: co-sell-ops-notes.pdf

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@consultly.com>

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner overlap — need a clearinghouse

Thanks everyone — Consultly is on board with the MAP_TEMPLATE approach. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- We generally record partner-sourced introductions in our CRM. We'll export evidence and attach to the form (email thread or registration ticket).
- For deals where we already have a signed MOU with the prospect, can we request an extended hold (7 business days) to allow coordination? We propose that extension be evaluated case-by-case and routed to Alliances.

Uploading a CSV from our side that matches Alex's list and adding context to four accounts where we've invested AE time. We'll use the form for the rest.

Priya Shah
VP Partnerships, Consultly
priya.shah@consultly.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner overlay clearinghouse — finalizing v1 and next steps

Appreciate the quick responses and alignment. Summary and next steps (agreed):

Decisions:
- Adopt Clearinghouse v1 immediately (MAP_TEMPLATE.xlsx) with default 72-hour validation window; 48-hour option for small deals (< $25k) as Ops suggested.
- Sales Ops (Jonas) to implement HubSpot properties/workflow this week and publish the weekly claims report.
- Alliances (Marissa) will run the weekly 30-min triage meeting and handle escalations after 72 hours.
- Extensions to 7 business days (MOU cases) will be handled case-by-case by Alliances + Regional Sales Lead.

Action items (owners):
- Marissa: publish MAP_TEMPLATE and update the shared sheet (by Wed 3/24).
- Jonas: HubSpot workflow + weekly report (deploy by Fri 3/26).
- Alex & Priya: start submitting current claims via MAP_TEMPLATE this week (link above).
- Neha: I'll be the official escalation contact for unresolved claims; route to me if needed.

I'll kick off the calendar invite for weekly clearing sync (Mon 11:00 PDT) and share the Drive link. Thanks all — let's measure adoption and revisit in 30 days.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Alliances & GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
